description: This file contains a static internal class 'JenkinsHash' implementing Jenkins hash functions, including a method to compute hash values over a span of bytes. It includes a specialized mixing function and is designed to be used internally within a storage component of Orleans.

classes.name: JenkinsHash
classes.description: A static class providing Jenkins hash function implementations, including a method to compute hash values from a read-only byte span.

methods.name: Mix
methods.description: A private static method that performs a series of bitwise and arithmetic operations to mix three uint values, used internally in the hash computation.

methods.name: ComputeHash
methods.description: A public static method that computes a Jenkins hash for a given span of bytes, processing data in 12-byte chunks and applying the Mix function.
